mapper.insert: insert into internship_time_settings ( application_start_date, application_end_date, company_confirmation_deadline, delay_application_deadline, report_cycle, start_date, end_date, report_deadline, evaluation_deadline, create_time, update_time, creator, updater, create_admin_id, update_admin_id, deleted ) values ( #{applicationStartDate}, #{applicationEndDate}, #{companyConfirmationDeadline}, #{delayApplicationDeadline}, #{reportCycle}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{reportDeadline}, #{evaluationDeadline}, NOW(), NOW(), #{creator}, #{updater}, #{createAdminId}, #{updateAdminId}, 0 )
mapper.select: select * from internship_time_settings where deleted = 0 order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update internship_time_settings set start_date = #{updated.startDate}, end_date = #{updated.endDate}, report_cycle = #{updated.reportCycle}, evaluation_deadline = #{updated.evaluationDeadline}, updater = #{updated.updater}, update_admin_id = #{updated.updateAdminId}, update_time = NOW() where id = #{current.id} and (update_time <=> #{current.updateTime}) and (start_date <=> #{current.startDate}) and (end_date <=> #{current.endDate}) and (report_cycle <=> #{current.reportCycle}) and (evaluation_deadline <=> #{current.evaluationDeadline})
